description: This Java interface 'CommandConfig' defines configuration settings for handling incoming commands via HTTP in a gateway, including methods for retrieving default and maximum timeout durations, and an inner enum 'CommandConfigValue' specifying known configuration path expressions and default values.

classes.name: CommandConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration holding known configuration path expressions and their default values for CommandConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue interface.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for a command.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for a command.
